Describe expected and observed numeric results, Python/dependency versions,
explicit timestamp/coordinate units, config, and command.

Attach a minimal synthetic CSV or generator, not raw participant recordings,
secrets or model checkpoints. State participant/session/trial boundaries and
whether missing gaze or blink observations are involved.

Specify a testable acceptance criterion and relevant research limitations.
